mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM referral_commission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 1 AND direction = 1

SELECT u.user_name AS userName, u.avatar AS avatar, rc.amount AS amount, rc.title AS title, rc.create_time AS createTime FROM referral_commission rc LEFT JOIN rent_order ro ON rc.order_id = ro.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON ro.user_id = u.user_id WHERE rc.user_id = #{userId} AND rc.type = 1 ORDER BY rc.create_time DESC
